verdict.rationale: NerdGraph's GraphQL API and the newrelic-cli's entity search/tagging across all accounts and entities suggest programmatic, multi-item operations are possible, and NRQL/alerts can be scripted for many signals at once. However, there is no explicit documentation of a 'bulk operation' feature (e.g., batch update/delete across many entities in one call) or hands-on evidence confirming scale/performance of such operations. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-update/bulk-delete API docs, and independent confirmation that bulk operations work reliably at scale.
